rationale: Mayor warns Kyiv faces dramatic situation as Russia intensifies strikes on critical infrastructure; Seoul threatens Ukraine over POW row, risking allied support; G7 oil release provides indirect energy relief. Score adjusted down: ongoing situation without qualitative change.

top_events.title: Intensified Russian strikes are tearing Kyiv apart, warns mayor
top_events.label: Kyiv mayor warns of dramatic strike escalation
top_events.summary: Mayor Klitschko warns capital faces very dramatic situation as Russia intensifies attacks on critical infrastructure, directly threatening civilian life and energy supply.

top_events.title: Seoul warns 'further action' if Ukraine does not apologise over prisoner-of-war row
top_events.label: Seoul escalates threats over POW dispute
top_events.summary: South Korea's president threatens further action and accuses Ukraine of provoking Korean Peninsula war, seriously risking crucial allied support during ongoing conflict.

top_events.title: G7 announces oil reserve release, as Trump hails Europe diesel deal
top_events.label: G7 releases oil reserves for energy relief
top_events.summary: G7 commits to 100 million barrel release over four months, providing indirect energy cost relief as Ukraine faces infrastructure attacks.

most_significant_event.label: Putin signals continued full-scale invasion
most_significant_event.summary: Russian president's foreign policy speech confirms ongoing full-scale invasion with no signs of de-escalation, maintaining existential threat.
most_significant_event.title: Putin shows no sign of stopping the war as Russia doubles down on Ukraine
